New original character painting for a classic coastal survival adventure. Repaint the ENTIRE single standing figure of Alick who is shown in the first reference, faithfully retaining his build, face type, standing pose, direction, relationship of silhouette to the canvas, and boot placement. Reference two shows this same man at work; it is for identity and clothing cuts only. Draw one man once, head to toe, at rest with both feet grounded and empty hands. The slim young adult deckhand from the references has a short dark beard, a charcoal-blue ribbed watch cap, a strong ochre neckcloth tucked into a work-softened slate-indigo pea jacket, warm smoke-brown wool trousers and worn tar-brown ankle boots. Give his narrow jaw, skin and thoughtful eyes individual character. His jacket is blue, never green.

Art direction: dramatic but restrained nineteenth-century naturalist gouache on a fine graphite underdrawing. A humane, anatomically observed face and work-worn hands, graceful contours, visible woven wool, salt-softened seams, hand-sewn linen, scumbled boot leather and creased broadcloth. Model the face and clothing with quiet warm flesh mids, deep legible folds, reflected slate sky light from the upper left and richer, finely varied local pigments. Paint shadow within the body, with a continuous broken ink edge; spare cel details in the distance, richer brush notes at the eyes, jaw, hands and cuffs. The image must feel individually hand-painted and tangibly three dimensional. Keep period working clothes simple. No photorealistic photography, oversized outline, comic proportions, uniform sepia wash, plastic shine or general green colour cast.

Professional game production sprite. The entire transparent portrait should have a 2:3 vertical canvas with an original 1024 by 1536 model-sheet composition. Match the reference's full-body standing scale and spacing with visible head margin and whole soles, all the way around. No ground, backdrop, paper outside the silhouette, cast shadow, plate, lettering, palette, title, frame or extra figure. Genuine wholly transparent outside, including between legs and arms. This freshly painted individual becomes the authoritative model for every walking and interaction frame.
